classification.reason: Restores two existing controls to the configured accepted vehicle quote destination, preserving copy and styling. The independent review explicitly approved no_experiment_needed for this bounded correctness repair; no new capability, claims or growth strategy was introduced.

publicProof.reportedBy: Codex connected-iMac verifier; supported Chrome extension and Checkly hosted Chromium
publicProof.summary: Independent live proof after production publication: all 16 CTA click cases passed across four routes, two controls and desktop/mobile viewports (23:25:15.867-23:26:02.380 UTC). Six local Chrome Tab/Enter destination cases passed on interstate, depot-to-depot and door-to-door. The final hosted commercial keyboard run passed both remaining Tab/focus/Enter cases in 16.1 seconds (23:49:08.784-23:49:22.350 UTC). Homepage Services navigation and mobile menu opening also passed. No forms were filled or submitted.

checks.before: Supported Mac Chrome observation on 2026-10-16 at 07:32 UTC showed both inert spans on interstate. The pre-repair source and published PR 79 deployment used those spans; no template or shared-runtime handler existed. This defect predates the Astro upgrade.
checks.after: PR 81 contract, lint, formatting, 40 tests, Astro checks, build and SEO/rendered-heading checks passed. Built HTML confirmed all eight controls used the accepted destination, with unchanged stylesheet bytes. Exact-head build, manifest validation, Netlify preview and redirect/header checks passed; post-merge build/manifest checks passed. Provider publication at 2026-10-16T22:25:20.869Z and the subsequent 16 clicks plus 8 keyboard destinations are separately evidenced in the dated report.

uncertainties: Browser evidence covers these four service routes and the stated navigation only, not the whole site; mobile is a 390x844 viewport, not a physical device or mobile user-agent.
Hosted tests used Chromium in Frankfurt. No quote calculation, form submission, authenticated workflow, conversion uplift or backend lead-record audit was performed.
Existing tracking appended lead-intent/source parameters. No form submission was invoked; backend side effects of ordinary link tracking were not inspected.
Earlier local commercial Enter navigation stalled with cause unknown. Both cases later passed in hosted Chromium; the local stall was not diagnosed or claimed fixed.
The door-to-door footer keyboard result survived a tool timeout via destination/source-path readback; only its observation window, not an exact per-case timestamp or Tab count, is retained.

Unsaved Checkly runs exposed no durable result-specific URL. Scripts, logs, screenshots, videos and traces are retained in the task and ChatGPT Library; the repository report records their hashes and limits.
Publication is source-reported repository evidence. Bossman intake and accepted owner recovery are separate and have not been triggered or claimed by this closeout.
